notes: 静态向量；本轮不执行。当前 Windows 无 host 产物，只能 legacy；D3 未拍板前不实现 named pipe。

vectors.title: chimera-host 不能为 Windows target 编译（std::os::unix）
vectors.command:
set +e
out="$(cargo check --manifest-path chimera-host/Cargo.toml --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc 2>&1)"
status=$?
set -e
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q "std::os::unix\|unresolved import"
if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then echo "unexpected windows build"; exit 1; fi
echo "windows host build fails as expected"

stdout_contains: windows host build fails as expected

vectors.cleanup: cargo 产物保留在 chimera-host/target；不写用户 home

vectors.title: publish 的 host-prebuild 矩阵不含 win32
vectors.command:
set -euo pipefail
grep -q '^  host-prebuild:' .github/workflows/publish.yml
section="$(sed -n '/^  host-prebuild:/,/^  build-cli:/p' .github/workflows/publish.yml)"
test -n "$section"
if printf '%s' "$section" | grep -q "win32"; then echo "windows host leg found"; exit 1; fi
echo "no windows host leg"

vectors.title: Windows named pipe 上完成 hello/ready/ack，错误身份返回 unauthorized
vectors.command:
set -euo pipefail
test_name="windows_named_pipe_handshake"
list="$(cargo test --manifest-path chimera-host/Cargo.toml -- --list 2>&1)"
printf '%s\n' "$list" | grep -E "${test_name}: test$"
out="$(cargo test --manifest-path chimera-host/Cargo.toml "$test_name" 2>&1)" || { printf '%s\n' "$out"; exit 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$out"
passed="$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed -n 's/^test result: ok\. \([0-9][0-9]*\) passed;.*/\1/p' | awk '{s += $1} END {print s + 0}')"
printf 'test_exists=yes passed=%s\n' "$passed"
test "$passed" -eq 1
vectors.notes: D3 决定是否支持 Windows host；不支持时本向量标记为 not-applicable，而不是 pass。目标测试名固定为 windows_named_pipe_handshake；命令先用 cargo test -- --list 确认存在，再要求总计恰好 1 passed。
